translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Taabootaa Oosuwaabaa
Bas'aali'eeli odooruwaa mitsaappe Taabootaa giigisseedda. He Taabootay adussatetsay laa"u wad'anne bagga aduk'k'ee; gomppay itti wad'anne bagga aakkee; geesaykka itti wad'anne bagga d'ok'k'ee.
He Taabootaa giigissiide, soyaanne kariyaa walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshsheedda; yuushshuwaakka work'k'aa tigetsaan yuushshi aatseedda.
K'ay oyddu work'k'aa sagaayetuwaa tigiide, Taabootaw oyddu gedetuwaan, itti baggana laa"u sagaayetuwaa, k'ay yenkko baggana laa"u sagaayetuwaa aatseedda.
Yaatiide odoorotuwaappe kasuwaa kessiide unttunttakka work'k'aan sheeshsheedda.
Taabootaa tookkanaw, Taabootaa miyyiyaan de'iyaa sagaayetuwaan kasuwaa aatseedda.
Walakay baynna work'k'aappe laa"u wad'anne bagga aduk'k'iyaa, itti wad'anne bagga aakkiyaa atto giyaa sa'aa k'um"iyaa med'd'eedda.
K'um"iyaw wurssetsa laa"u bagga gas'an laa"u kiruubeelatuwaa k'os'etteedda work'k'aappe med'd'eedda.
Itti kiruubiyaa itti bagga gas'an, laa'entso kiruubiyaa yenkko bagga gas'an, laa'uwaakka k'um"iyaanna gatsi oytsiidde med'd'eedda.
Kiruubetuu barenttu k'efiyaa dentsiide, atto giyaa sa'aa kammiyaa k'um"iyaa barenttu k'efiyaan kuway wotseeddino; k'ay ittuu ittuwaakko simmi uttiide, k'um"iyaa s'eeliino.
S'arp'p'eezaa
K'ay adussatetsay laa"u wad'aa, gomppay itti wad'aa, geesaykka itti wad'anne bagga gideedda s'arp'p'eezaa odooruwaappe med'd'eedda.
Walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshsheedda. Yuushshuwaakka work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushshi aatseedda.
Hewaadankka, gomppay takkaad'e gideedda shaashiyaa Aa bolla yuushshi aatseedda. Yaatiide Aa bolla work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushsheedda.
Oyddu work'k'aa sagaayetuwaa med'd'iide oyddu gedetuu med'etteedda oyddu gas'atuwaana oytseedda.
S'arp'p'eezaa tookkanaw kasuwaa aatsiyaa sagaayetuu s'arp'p'eezaw shaashiyaa gas'aan shiik'iide med'etteeddino.
S'arap'p'eezaa tookkiyaa kasotuwaakka odooruwaappe kessiide, work'k'aan sheeshsheedda.

Hewaadankka, s'arp'p'eezaa bolla wotsiyaa dumma dumma miishshatuwaa walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'eedda; hewanttukka saanetuwaanne c'ilppatuwaa, k'ay ushshaa yarshshuwaa tigiyaa keretuwaanne s'uu'atuwaa.
S'omppiyaa Wotsiyaa Ballaa

Hewaappe guyyiyaan I s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballaa k'os'etteedda walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'eedda; he ballaa essiyaa gediyaakka, giddo toomaakka k'os's'eedda work'k'aappe med'd'eedda. Aa kukkumotuwaa, Aa lic'otuwaan Aa c'iishshatuwaa ubbaa aanana ittippe s'omppiidde med'd'eedda.
Miyyiyaanna usuppun maratuwaa med'd'eedda; maratuwaa heezzatuwaa itti baggana, k'ay heezzatuwaa yenkko baggana kesseedda.
Usuppun maratookka huup'iyaan huup'iyaan heezzu heezzu kukkumuunne c'iishshatuu de'iyaa lawuziyaa c'iishshaa malatiyaa wanc'c'aa med'd'eedda;
s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballaw giddo toomay, kukkumotuwaa c'iishshatuu de'iyaa c'iishshaa malatiyaa oyddu wanc'c'aan alleek'k'etti utteedda.
Laa"uu laa"uu ittippe waatsan de'iyaa heezzu maratuwaappe garssana itti itti kukkumay med'etti utteedda ubbaykka usuppun kuukummo.
Kukkumatuunne maratuu ubbay s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballana ittippe oyk'k'etti ittuwaa gidiide, walakay baynna work'k'aappe k'os'ettiide med'etteeddino.
I k'ay s'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballaw laappun s'omppetuwaa, s'omppiyaa toyssiyaa k'ap'etuwaanne unttuntta wotsiyaawantta walakay baynna work'k'aappe med'd'eedda.
S'omppiyaa wotsiyaa ballanne an go'ettiyaa miishshaa ubbaa med'd'anaw hattamanne ichcheshu kiilo giraame gideedda walakay baynna work'k'aa wursseedda.
Is'aanaa C'uwissiyaa Saas'iniyaa

K'ay is'aanaa c'uwissiyaa sa'aa odooruwaappe med'd'eedda. Aw oyddu gas'ay de'ee; adussatetsay itti wad'aa; gomppay itti wad'aa, geesay laa"u wad'aa. Aa kac'etuukka aanana ittuwaa gidiide oyk'k'etti med'etteeddawantta.
Aw bolla doonaa, oyddu bagga ubbaanne Aa kac'etuwaa walakay baynna work'k'aan sheeshshiide, Aa yuushshuwaakka work'k'aa tigetsaa yuushshi aatseedda.

He work'k'aa tigetsaappe garssana is'aanaa c'uwissiyaa saas'iniyaa work'k'aappe laa"u sagaayetuwaa med'd'eedda; yaatiide ya baggananne ha baggana laa"uwaa laa"uwaa oytseedda. Hewanttu tookkiyaa wode kasuwaa aatsanaw maaddanaadaana.
Kasotuwaa odooruwaappe kessiide, unttuntta work'k'aan sheeshsheedda.
Zayitiyaanne Is'aanaa
K'ay geeshsha okettiyaa zayitiyaanne sawuwaa toshikku giyaa lo"o is'aanaa shittuwaa ootsiyaa eran giigisseedda.
